summary_en: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings announced on 17 November 2025 that its subsidiary Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance agreed to buy an 18% stake in the asset manager Barings LLC from MassMutual for US$1.44 billion. Barings will become an equity-method affiliate. The deal includes seed investment, asset management mandates, and staff secondments to Barings. It also opens a link with the reinsurer Martello Re. Closing is expected after regulatory approvals, with no date given.

summary_en: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings announced on 5 March 2026 that its subsidiary Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance has completed, as planned, the purchase of 15% of the common shares of US insurer W.R. Berkley Corporation. All the shares were bought on the market under a cooperation agreement with the Berkley founding family. Mitsui Sumitomo will send one director to Berkley, subject to the family's recommendation and approval by the relevant Berkley committee. Voting rights will be coordinated with the family's, and Berkley's profits will be included in consolidated results in proportion to the stake.
